unlabelled_rationale: Everything inside labelled_span that is not a delivery and not neutral is unique content. Since D-379 every repeat is labelled at word precision, including within-segment stutters, so a whole-segment detector that cannot express one simply scores lower recall on it. Not labelled: Whisper's segment-boundary duplicates ('every / every call', 'open / Open', 'started. / started.'), which are transcription artifacts — Parakeet hears each word once.
